title: SomBench: Benchmark Dataset for Advancing Machine Learning in Lunar Science
abstract: arXiv:2609.13277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lunar orbital missions, such as Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, Kaguya/SELENE, Gravity Recovery and Interior Laboratory, and Lunar Prospector, among others, provide rich multi-instrument observations, but their heterogeneity in sampling, projection, and conventions limits reproducible machine learning (ML). We introduce SomBench, a unified, spatially-aligned, ML-ready lunar dataset aggregating 30+ co-registered layers from ten instruments across four missions, spanning 1 meter to 20 kilometer/pixel and covering 82 degree latitude in 90 Lunar Transverse Mercator zones with two polar stereographic caps. An image-anchored tiling pipeline yields pretraining-ready multimodal tile views with leakage-safe splits, distributed as netCDF with Parquet catalogs. An application benchmark suite spans impact processes, volcanic history, and polar volatiles. Baseline experiments with ResNet-50 and SwinV2-B models confirm that each benchmark task is lear

translated_title: SomBench：推进月球科学机器学习的基准数据集
translated_abstract: 月球轨道任务，如月球勘测轨道器、月亮女神号、重力恢复与内部实验室以及月球探勘者等，提供了丰富的多仪器观测数据，但它们在采样、投影和规范方面的异质性限制了可重现的机器学习（ML）研究。我们推出了SomBench，这是一个统一的、空间对齐的、面向机器学习的月球数据集，汇集了来自四个任务中十台仪器的30多个共同配准图层，空间分辨率覆盖1米到20公里/像素，在90个月球横轴墨卡托投影带中覆盖82度纬度范围，并包含两个极地立体投影帽。基于图像锚定的切片流水线生成了可用于预训练的多模态切片视图，并具有防泄漏的数据划分，以netCDF格式和Parquet目录进行分发。应用基准测试套件涵盖撞击过程、火山历史和极地挥发物。使用ResNet-50和SwinV2-B模型的基线实验证实了每个基准任务的可学习性（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: SomBench是一个统一的、空间对齐的、面向机器学习的月球科学基准数据集，汇集了四个月球轨道任务中十台仪器的30多个共同配准图层，并提供涵盖撞击过程、火山历史和极地挥发物的应用基准任务。
en_tdlr: SomBench is a unified, spatially-aligned, ML-ready lunar benchmark dataset aggregating 30+ co-registered layers from ten instruments across four missions, with application benchmarks spanning impact processes, volcanic history, and polar volatiles.
